subject: Clarify SLA thresholds, deployment options, and procurement path
messages:

Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena@mediscale.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Dec 2027 15:42:00 -0800
Subject: Thanks for the demo — two quick clarifications

Diego, thanks again for walking us through the Hosted vs Dedicated flow just now — really helpful. Two quick things the execs asked me to confirm before I pull procurement in:  

1) SLA targets: can you confirm your P95 token latency SLA for the Dedicated plan at our anticipated QPS (we estimated 75 qps peak for 2ms avg seq lengths), and whether there's an escalation path if we spike above reserved capacity?

2) Hosting & data residency: we heard about Private (VPC) deployments; for our PHI pipeline we need VPC-internal control and KMS integration. Is that same-package available during initial commit or only as later migration?

If you can give me a short note I can tee up procurement.

—Samir
Senior Product Manager
MediScale Health

From: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
To: Samir Joshi <samir.joshi@mediscale.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 1 Dec 2027 16:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Thanks for the demo — two quick clarifications

Samir — great questions, appreciate the rapid follow-up. Short answers up front, details below and attaching a compact SLA/options sheet.

1) Dedicated P95 SLA: For Dedicated with your traffic profile (75 qps peak, short sequences ~32 tokens on average), our committed P95 tail latency SLA is 180ms per response under the standard reserved-capacity contract. That assumes properly sized GPU pool (we'd propose a 4-GPU pool with autoscale headroom). If you need a tighter P95 (<=120ms), we can discuss a higher-tier SLA or an optimized routing profile + priority traffic lanes.

Escalation: We have a two-tier escalation for capacity spikes — automatic burst to shared warm capacity (up to 20% above reservation) and an SLA credit + live on-call escalation if autoscale doesn't stabilize within 10 minutes. I'll include the exact escalation contacts in the procurement bundle.

2) Private/VPC: We can onboard you initially on Dedicated (isolated GPU pool + customer data segmentation) and run a Private VPC deployment in parallel as a migration path. However, if you need customer-managed KMS and no egress via our control plane from day one, we recommend starting with Private (VPC) — that requires an enterprise setup (Private licensing + networking kickoff). We'll summarize options in the attached PDF.

Next steps I propose: 
- I’ll loop in Marissa (security lead) to confirm KMS and SOC2 items you’ll need for procurement.
- Neha (solutions procurement) will attach a procurement checklist and typical timelines.
- If acceptable, we can produce a mutual action plan and a draft SOW for the Dedicated -> Private migration.

Samir — copied Marissa and Neha. Marissa, Neha: please see Samir’s asks inline and advise.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Samir Joshi <samir.joshi@mediscale.com>, diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 2 Dec 2027 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Thanks for the demo — two quick clarifications

Hi Samir — quick security/compliance clarifications from my side:

- KMS/HSM: For Private deployments we support customer-managed KMS via AWS KMS or a hosted HSM (bring-your-key). That is available only on Private deployments (not on Hosted). On Dedicated we encrypt at rest with customer-specific keys managed by Redwood but we cannot provide a customer-kept KMS until Private is provisioned.

- Audit logs: We provide per-tenant audit logs with retention configurable (30/90/365 days). For PHI workloads we recommend 365-day retention and will include the audit log export steps in the SOW.

- SOC 2 / Pen tests: We have a SOC 2 Type II report and can provide a current copy under NDA; penetration-test artifacts are provided to customers under a redaction agreement.

I'll attach a short matrix mapping Deployment Mode -> Key Management -> Audit options.

Marissa Cole
Head of Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
To: Procurement Team <procurement@mediscale.com>, Samir Joshi <samir.joshi@mediscale.com>, diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 3 Dec 2027 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Thanks for the demo — procurement checklist and timelines

Hi Samir / Procurement team — looping in the standard procurement checklist and expected timeline for Dedicated -> Private conversions. See attached spreadsheet. Key items to highlight: 

- Purchase order vs. SOW: small pilots (under $50k) generally run on PO + standard terms (30 days). Enterprise Private deployments require SOW + deployment milestones and typically 45–60 day lead time for network setup.
- Security review: receiving SOC2 + network diagrams typically closes the security gate in 5 business days once NDA is signed.
- Billing and SLA: Dedicated is billed monthly; Private is billed on a quarterly invoice schedule for the platform license. SLA credits are defined in the SOW.

Please confirm if Procurement wants the draft SOW (I can share a redlined template) or a PO-based pilot quote.

Cheers,
Neha Kapoor
Solutions Procurement Lead | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Thanks for the demo — clarify SLA thresholds, deployment options, and procurement path

Samir — quick summary and requested decision points so procurement can move forward: 

1) Decide SLA target: 
   - Option A (standard): Dedicated P95 = 180ms, monthly billing, 4-GPU reserved pool with 20% automatic burst.
   - Option B (aggressive): Dedicated P95 <= 120ms with higher-tier SLA (additional premium) + routing priority lanes.

2) Deployment mode to start: 
   - Start Dedicated now (faster time-to-value; migration path to Private for KMS and full control) OR
   - Start Private now (preferred if you need KMS/HSM managed by you from day one; adds ~45–60 days to kickoff).

3) Procurement route: PO pilot (<$50k, PO + standard terms) OR SOW/Enterprise (Private or multi-quarter commitments).

Please reply with the combination that fits your timeline and I’ll produce a one-page mutual action plan and a draft SOW/PO quote. If helpful, we can schedule a 30-minute procurement + security call this week (I’m available Wed/Thu mornings PST).

—Aditya Rao
Solution Engineering Manager | Redwood Inference
